trans-unit.source: It's okay if both trailers won't fit in one lane - in fact, it may even be better to straddle both lanes so that an optimistic motorist doesn't try to pass you.
trans-unit.target: 트레일러가 한 차선에 다 들어가지 않아도 괜찮습니다. 오히려 두 차선을 나눠서 가는 것이 더 나을 수도 있습니다. 그래야 다른 운전자가 추월하려고 하지 않을 테니까요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: Drive to the far side of your exit lane to again ensure both trailers are clear of any potential collisions.
trans-unit.target: 출구 차선의 반대편으로 운전하여 두 트레일러 모두 잠재적 충돌이 없는지 다시 한 번 확인하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene5 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: This roundabout only has one lane, so take your time and be precise.
trans-unit.target: 이 회전교차로는 차선이 하나뿐이니 서두르지 말고 정확하게 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene6 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: Use all of the room available to you - cutting corners here will only make things more difficult.
trans-unit.target: 주어진 공간을 최대한 활용하세요. 여기서 요령을 부리면 오히려 일이 더 어려워질 뿐입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene7
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene7 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: Take the exit and proceed towards the parking area.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene8
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene8 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene9
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_cutscene9 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: You're on a course designed to familiarize you with negotiating roundabouts. Proceed forward when you're ready.
trans-unit.target: 이 코스는 여러분이 회전교차로를 통과하는 방법을 익히도록 설계되었습니다. 준비가 되면 앞으로 나아가십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: Drive well into the roundabout before heading towards the outer cones to ensure both trailers enter safely.
trans-unit.target: 두 트레일러가 안전하게 진입할 수 있도록 회전교차로 안쪽으로 깊숙이 들어간 후 바깥쪽 콘 방향으로 향하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source:
You'll want to drive to the far side of the exit to keep your trailers off the cones.

It may help to turn towards the centre of the roundabout just before exiting it.
trans-unit.target:
트레일러가 콘에 닿지 않도록 출구의 가장 안쪽으로 운전해 가시는 것이 좋습니다.

회전교차로를 나가기 직전에 로터리 중앙 쪽으로 방향을 틀면 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_check2
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

trans-unit.source: You should be able to negotiate this one on your own, take your time and use your space wisely.
trans-unit.target: 이 문제는 혼자서도 충분히 해결할 수 있을 겁니다. 서두르지 말고 공간을 현명하게 활용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_3_11_check4
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_check4 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

aca_msg_book3_3_11_check5
Id: aca_msg_book3_3_11_check5 Group: Book 3 Scenario infinite Fun

aca_goal_book3_diag_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_diag_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

aca_scenario_book3_diag_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_diag_title Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll park your B-double combination in a diagonal parking spot in a busy lot.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 혼잡한 주차장의 대각선 주차 공간에 B-더블 트레일러 차량을 주차하게 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_diag_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_diag_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Diagonal parking spots like this are very common. They're especially common in older truck stops, as well as the many rest areas across America's interstates.
trans-unit.target: 이런 대각선 주차는 아주 흔합니다. 특히 오래된 트럭 휴게소나 미국 고속도로 곳곳의 휴게소에서 흔히 볼 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Drive towards the designated parking spot near the end of the row.
trans-unit.target: 줄 끝 근처에 있는 지정된 주차 장소를 향해 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Stay towards the outside of the lane, but not tight against the barriers as the rear of the trailer may strike them during the turn in.
trans-unit.target: 차선 바깥쪽으로 주행하되, 장벽에 너무 바짝 붙어서 주행하지 마십시오. 회전 시 트레일러 뒤쪽이 방호벽에 부딪힐 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Drive past the parking spot to make room for both trailers to follow you in. Then dive towards the far side of the spot to bring your first trailer into position.
trans-unit.target: 주차 공간을 지나쳐 두 트레일러가 뒤따라 들어올 수 있도록 자리를 만드세요. 그런 다음 주차 공간의 반대편으로 이동하여 첫 번째 트레일러를 제 위치에 놓으십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Straighten out, then stop in the designated area and secure the truck.
trans-unit.target: 똑바로 멈추고 지정된 장소에 정지하고 트럭을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_cutscene5 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Proceed towards the end of the row and find your parking spot.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Drive past the parking spot to make sure your rear trailer will track correctly into the spot, then turn in while sharply ensuring the front of your lead trailer doesn't contact the truck next to you.
trans-unit.target: 주차 공간을 지나쳐 뒤쪽 트레일러가 주차 공간에 제대로 들어가는지 확인한 다음, 앞쪽 트레일러 앞부분이 옆 트럭에 닿지 않도록 주의하면서 급하게 회전하여 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

trans-unit.source: Continue slowly while straightening up the combination, then stop in the designated area.
trans-unit.target: 조합을 곧게 펴면 천천히 진행한 다음 지정된 위치에서 멈추십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_diag_stop
Id: aca_msg_book3_diag_stop Group: Book 3 Scenario Diag

aca_scenario_book3_train_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_train_title Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll take a drive on a training course designed to mimic realistic turns and manoeuvrers.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 실제와 같은 회전과 조작을 모방하도록 설계된 훈련 코스에서 주행을 해볼 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_train_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_train_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario train

aca_goal_book3_train_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_train_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

aca_goal_book3_train_check2
Id: aca_goal_book3_train_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source:
This training course will give you a small taste of real world driving within the safety of our training grounds. Put some of your new skills to the test, and remember to be aware of your surroundings and to use all of the room available to you.

It also pays to think ahead!
trans-unit.target:
이 교육 과정은 안전한 교육장에서 실제 운전을 조금이나마 경험해 볼 수 있는 기회를 제공합니다. 새로 익힌 운전 기술을 시험해 보고, 주변 상황을 항상 살피며, 주어진 공간을 최대한 활용하는 것을 잊지 마세요.

미리 계획하는 것도 중요합니다!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: Proceed forward and follow the designated route.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: Use all of the room available to you, as these turns can be very tight.
trans-unit.target: 회전 구간이 매우 좁을 수 있으므로 사용 가능한 모든 공간을 활용하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: Turn into the depot and make your way past the obstacles, then proceed around the office.
trans-unit.target: 차고지로 들어가 장애물을 지나 사무실 한 바퀴 돌면 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_check2
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

aca_msg_book3_train_check3
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_check3 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: Follow the course laid out by the cones.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_check4
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_check4 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

trans-unit.source: Continue driving to the final parking area.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_train_check5
Id: aca_msg_book3_train_check5 Group: Book 3 Scenario train

aca_scenario_book3_double_90_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_double_90_title Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll be tasked with driving through a course of 90-degree turns with varying difficulty.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 난이도가 다양한 90도 커브 코스를 운전해서 통과해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_double_90_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_double_90_desc Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_start
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_start Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_forward
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_forward Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_check1 Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_check2
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_check2 Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_check3
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_check3 Group: double_90

aca_goal_book3_double_90_check4
Id: aca_goal_book3_double_90_check4 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: The course ahead will help familiarize you with turning B-doubles through 90-degree turns with varying difficulty.
trans-unit.target: 앞으로 진행될 과정은 다양한 난이도의 90도 회전을 통해 B-더블 회전에 익숙해지는 데 도움이 될 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene01 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: The first few corners are quite wide, with lots of room. Use these to get a feel of the trailers behind you as your turn.
trans-unit.target: 처음 몇 개의 코너는 상당히 넓어서 공간이 충분합니다. 이 구간을 활용하여 회전할 때 뒤따라오는 트레일러와의 간격을 느껴보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene02 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: From here on, the turns will get tighter and more technical. Approach them slowly, and ensure you drive deep into the turns so that your trailers have room to track around the corner behind you.
trans-unit.target: 이제부터는 커브길이 점점 더 좁아지고 기술적인 난이도가 높아집니다. 천천히 접근하시고, 트레일러가 코너를 돌아 나올 공간을 확보하기 위해 커브 안쪽으로 깊숙이 진입하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene03 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: This is one of the tightest turns on the course. It may help to utilize the small space on the right to help get your trailers around those pesky inside cones.
trans-unit.target: 이 구간은 코스에서 가장 좁은 커브 중 하나입니다. 오른쪽의 좁은 공간을 활용하면 안쪽의 까다로운 콘들을 피해 트레일러를 쉽게 통과시킬 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene04 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: The next turn should always be in the back of your mind - as you exit one turn, make a plan on how you will prepare for the next.
trans-unit.target: 다음 회전을 항상 염두에 두어야 합니다. 한 회전을 마치고 나면 다음 회전을 어떻게 준비할지 계획을 세우십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene05
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene05 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: Always pay attention to your trailers right through until they are clear of any obstacles.
trans-unit.target: 트레일러가 장애물을 완전히 피할 때까지 항상 주의 깊게 살펴보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_cutscene06 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: Proceed forwards towards the first turn.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_forward Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: Pay attention to your mirrors as you go to understand how the trailers track behind you.
trans-unit.target: 주행 중에는 백미러를 주의 깊게 살펴보고 뒤따라오는 트레일러의 움직임을 파악하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_check1 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: Stay wide before each turn, this is crucial to give yourself the room you need to get the trailers around the corner.
trans-unit.target: 커브를 돌기 전에는 항상 넓게 주행하십시오. 이는 트레일러가 코너를 돌 때 필요한 공간을 확보하는 데 매우 중요합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_check2
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_check2 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source:
The set-up for the next few corners is crucial, as there is a very tight curve after. A mistake at the beginning can cost you even later.

Be slow and meticulous, and pay attention to your surroundings.
trans-unit.target:
다음 몇 개의 코너를 위한 준비 동작이 매우 중요합니다. 그 이후에는 매우 급커브가 이어지기 때문입니다. 초반에 실수를 하면 나중에 더 큰 손해를 볼 수 있습니다.

천천히, 꼼꼼하게 운전하고 주변 상황에 주의를 기울이십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_check3
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_check3 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: This turn is extremely tight, and leads directly into another tight turn. You'll not only need to consider how you enter the turn, but also how you exit and set up for the next one.
trans-unit.target: 이 코너는 매우 좁고, 바로 다음 코너로 이어집니다. 코너 진입 방법뿐만 아니라 코너 탈출 및 다음 코너 준비까지 고려해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_check4
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_check4 Group: double_90

trans-unit.source: Continue driving through the final turns towards the designated area.
trans-unit.target: 지정된 구역을 향해 마지막 커브길들을 계속 운전하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_double_90_check5
Id: aca_msg_book3_double_90_check5 Group: double_90

aca_scenario_book3_justb_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_justb_title Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll reverse a B-double combination for the very first time.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 처음으로 B-더블 조합을 후진해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_justb_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_justb_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

aca_goal_book3_justb_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_justb_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
Reversing with B-doubles requires a whole new way of thinking about what you're doing. Rather than just steering a trailer, you are now using your lead trailer to steer one behind it.

Use this scenario to get a feel for how it all works. There is no specific goal, just take your time and try to understand what is going on.
trans-unit.target:
B-더블로 후진하려면 완전히 새로운 사고방식이 필요합니다. 단순히 앞쪽 트레일러를 조종하는 것이 아니라, 앞쪽 트레일러를 이용해 뒤쪽 트레일러를 조종해야 합니다.

다음 시나리오를 통해 작동 방식을 익혀보세요. 특별한 목표는 없으니, 시간을 갖고 상황을 이해하려고 노력하면 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
From a straight position, you can turn your truck the same direction you want the rear trailer to go.

Don't over do it; you only need to get the rear trailer heading towards the direction you want it to go, and then you can align your tractor with the lead trailer and let the rear trailer do its thing.
trans-unit.target:
직진 상태에서 트럭을 원하는 방향으로 돌려 후방 트레일러가 이동하도록 할 수 있습니다.

너무 과하게 돌리지 마세요. 후방 트레일러가 원하는 방향으로 향하도록만 돌리면 되고, 그 후 트랙터를 선두 트레일러와 정렬한 다음 후방 트레일러가 알아서 움직이도록 두면 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
Once your rear trailer is heading where you want it to go, you can steer the lead trailer to follow the same direction.

Once the lead is following the rear, use the tractor to adjust the angle between the two trailers to either make a tighter turn or a wider sweeping turn.
trans-unit.target:
뒤쪽 트레일러가 원하는 방향으로 향하면 앞쪽 트레일러도 같은 방향으로 따라가도록 조종할 수 있습니다.

앞쪽 트레일러가 뒤쪽 트레일러를 따라가기 시작하면 트랙터를 사용하여 두 트레일러 사이의 각도를 조정하여 더 좁은 회전이나 더 넓은 회전을 할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
There is no exact formula to get this right, you just have to pay attention to what is going on, learn from your mistakes, and keep practising.

Once you are satisfied, you can head for the designated area and secure the vehicle.

Feel free to spend as much time here experimenting as you feel you need.
trans-unit.target:
정확한 공식은 없으니, 상황을 잘 관찰하고, 실수에서 배우고, 꾸준히 연습하세요.

만족스러우면 지정된 장소로 이동하여 차량을 안전하게 고정하세요.

이곳에서 원하는 만큼 시간을 들여 연습해 보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
Begin reversing slowly. Remember to just start with small inputs, there's not need to jack-knife everything right off the bat.

Try to go straight back, or bring the trailers to the driver's side.
trans-unit.target:
천천히 후진을 시작합니다. 처음에는 조금씩만 조작하고, 처음부터 급하게 방향을 틀 필요는 없습니다.

직선으로 후진하거나 트레일러를 운전석 쪽으로 가져오십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

trans-unit.source:
Take your time and don't get frustrated.

Every master was once a beginner.
trans-unit.target:
천천히 하세요. 좌절하지 마세요.

모든 고수는 한때 초보자였습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justb_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_justb_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justb

aca_scenario_book3_justc_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_justc_title Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll have to pick up where someone else left off.
trans-unit.target: 이런 상황에서는 다른 사람이 중단한 부분부터 다시 시작해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_justc_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_justc_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

aca_goal_book3_justc_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_justc_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source: Uh oh! Someone else got a little frustrated while reversing and left their truck in the middle of the lot.
trans-unit.target: 어머나! 누군가 후진하다가 짜증이 나서 주차장 한가운데에 트럭을 세워두고 가버렸네요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source:
There will inevitably be times where you will get completely screwed up. Not to worry, just pull forward out of the jack-knife until you have something you can work with.

If you aren't sure, aim to get it all straight so you have a clean slate.
trans-unit.target:
어쩔 수 없이 완전히 엉망이 되는 순간이 있을 겁니다. 걱정하지 마세요. 잭나이프처럼 접힌 상태에서 앞으로 당겨서 다시 작업할 수 있는 상태로 만들면 됩니다.

확실하지 않다면, 처음부터 다시 시작할 수 있도록 모든 것을 똑바로 정리하는 것을 목표로 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source: This is a decent position to start from. The rear trailer is still pointed where we want it to go, and we can quickly get the tractor in front of the lead to start steering the whole combination where we want to go.
trans-unit.target: 이 정도면 출발하기에 괜찮은 위치입니다. 뒤쪽 트레일러는 여전히 우리가 원하는 방향을 향하고 있고, 트랙터를 앞쪽으로 빠르게 이동시켜 전체 차량을 원하는 방향으로 조종할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source:
proceed to the designated area and secure the truck.

Once again, you can practise with this scenario until you are comfortable manoeuvring the trailers.
trans-unit.target:
지정된 구역으로 이동하여 트럭을 고정하십시오.

트레일러 조작에 익숙해질 때까지 이 시나리오를 반복해서 연습할 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

trans-unit.source: There's no way out of this mess. Pull forward so you have something to work with.
trans-unit.target: 이 엉망진창에서 벗어날 방법이 없어. 앞으로 당겨서 작업할 공간을 확보해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_justc_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

aca_msg_book3_justc_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_justc_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario justc

aca_scenario_book3_straight_backing_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_straight_backing_title Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you must reverse a set of B-doubles in a straight line.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 B-더블 세트를 직선으로 후진해야야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_straight_backing_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_straight_backing_desc Group: Straight Backing

aca_goal_book3_straight_backing_forward
Id: aca_goal_book3_straight_backing_forward Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source:
Straight backing may seem easier at first glance, but it is actually much more difficult.

Rather than just increasing or decreasing the angle between the trailers on one side, you must now work both sides to keep the combination straight.
trans-unit.target:
직선 후진은 언뜻 보기에 쉬워 보일 수 있지만, 실제로는 훨씬 더 어렵습니다.

단순히 한쪽 트레일러 사이의 각도를 늘리거나 줄이는 것뿐만 아니라, 이제는 양쪽을 모두 조작하여 차량 전체를 직선으로 유지해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene01 Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Start with relatively small corrections. It's okay if you end up wiggling and waggling to each side, just keep in mind that you will need to hold the angle between the truck and the lead trailer a bit longer to change the angle between the lead and rear trailers.
trans-unit.target: 비교적 작은 조정을 시작하세요. 좌우로 약간씩 흔들려도 괜찮습니다. 다만, 앞쪽과 뒤쪽 트레일러 사이의 각도를 변경하려면 트럭과 앞쪽 트레일러 사이의 각도를 유지하는 시간이 조금 더 길어질 수 있다는 점을 기억하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene02 Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: You may need to make some quite large manoeuvres with the tractor to keep the rear trailer pointed where you want it, but just try not to over-do it in the first place and you won't have to.
trans-unit.target: 트레일러 뒷부분이 원하는 방향을 유지하도록 트랙터를 상당히 크게 조작해야 할 수도 있지만, 처음부터 과도하게 조작하지 않도록 주의하면 그럴 필요가 없을 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene03 Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: You can pull forward to correct yourself as many times as necessary. As long as you end up in the parking spot safely, the rest is trivial.
trans-unit.target: 필요하다면 몇 번이고 앞으로 움직여 자세를 바로잡을 수 있습니다. 안전하게 주차 공간에 들어가기만 하면 나머지는 간단합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_cutscene04 Group: Straight Backing

aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_forward Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Straighten up and stop in the designated area.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_stop
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_stop Group: Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Secure the vehicle and shut off the engine.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_end
Id: aca_msg_book3_straight_backing_end Group: Straight Backing

aca_scenario_book3_correcting_straight_backing_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_correcting_straight_backing_title Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you will take the wheel after someone else has already attempted a straight reverse. Correct their mistake and park the truck in the designated spot.
trans-unit.target: 이 상황에서는 다른 사람이 후진을 시도한 후 운전대를 잡게 됩니다. 실수를 바로잡고 지정된 위치에 트럭을 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_correcting_straight_backing_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_correcting_straight_backing_desc Group: Correcting Straight Backing

aca_goal_book3_correcting_straight_backing_forward
Id: aca_goal_book3_correcting_straight_backing_forward Group: Correcting Straight Backing

aca_goal_book3_correcting_straight_backing_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_correcting_straight_backing_check1 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Someone has attempted to reverse this combination into the parking spot and had a little trouble. Now it's up to you to fix it!
trans-unit.target: 누군가 이 차를 후진 주차하려고 시도하다가 약간 어려움을 겪었습니다. 이제 당신이 해결해야 할 차례입니다!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene01 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: The first step is to pull forward and get everything straightened out into something we can work with. It's crucial to have the rear trailer pointed where you want it to go.
trans-unit.target: 첫 번째 단계는 트레일러를 앞으로 당겨서 모든 것을 정리하고 작업하기 쉬운 상태로 만드는 것입니다. 트레일러 뒷부분이 원하는 방향을 향하도록 하는 것이 매우 중요합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene02 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source:
In this case, we've chosen to go more towards the driver side. This will give us a better view of what we are doing as we reverse, and allow us to work from one side.

Remember, you are steering the rear trailer with the lead, so don't focus on the tractor so much.
trans-unit.target:
이 경우에는 운전석 쪽으로 시야를 더 확보하기로 합니다. 이렇게 하면 후진할 때 작업 상황을 더 잘 파악할 수 있고, 한쪽에서만 작업할 수 있습니다.

앞쪽 트레일러는 앞쪽 차량으로 조종해야 하므로 트랙터에 너무 집중하지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene03 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: The combination is more or less where we need it, but let's pull forward again to centre it properly.
trans-unit.target: 조합은 대략 원하는 위치에 있지만, 제대로 중앙에 오도록 다시 앞으로 당겨 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene04
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene04 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: From here, we will very delicately reverse into place, making sure the rear trailer stays perfectly on track.
trans-unit.target: 여기서부터 우리는 뒤쪽 트레일러가 완벽하게 궤도를 유지하도록 매우 조심스럽게 후진하여 제자리에 주차할 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene05
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene05 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Now we can line up the lead trailer and the tractor itself.
trans-unit.target: 이제 앞쪽 트레일러와 트랙터를 나란히 세울 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene06
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_cutscene06 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source:
Pull forward and straighten everything up.

Once you are satisfied, reverse into the designated area.
trans-unit.target:
앞으로 당겨서 모든 것을 똑바로 정렬하세요.

모든 것이 만족스러우면 지정된 주차 공간으로 후진하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_forward Group: Correcting Straight Backing

aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_check1 Group: Correcting Straight Backing

trans-unit.source: Secure the vehicle and shut off the engine.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_end
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_straight_backing_end Group: Correcting Straight Backing

aca_scenario_book3_backing_90_tight_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_backing_90_tight_title Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll use a 90-degree backing manoeuvre to park in a row of other trucks.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 90도 후진 조작을 사용하여 다른 트럭들을 일렬로 주차할 것입니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_backing_90_tight_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_backing_90_tight_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check2
Id: aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check3
Id: aca_goal_book3_backing_90_tight_check3 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Reversing to the side is easier with B-doubles, as you will have a clearer vantage point out of the side window of everything going on.
trans-unit.target: B-더블은 측면 창문을 통해 주변 상황을 더 잘 파악할 수 있어 측면으로 후진하기가 더 쉽습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: First, drive forward and make a u-turn at the end of the row. This will allow you to set up from the sight side, allowing you too see things better out of your driver's side window.
trans-unit.target: 먼저 앞으로 전진한 후 줄 끝에서 유턴하세요. 이렇게 하면 시야 확보가 잘 되는 쪽에서 자리를 잡을 수 있어 운전석 창문으로 주변을 더 잘 볼 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source:
You may choose to set up the trailers however you see fit, perhaps with the rear trailer already pointing towards the spot. In this case, we will start from a straight position.

Remember to keep it simple - steer the rear trailer with the lead.
trans-unit.target:
트레일러는 원하시는 대로 설정하면 됩니다, 예를 들어, 뒤쪽 트레일러를 미리 목적지 방향으로 향하게 설치할 수도 있습니다, 이 경우에는 직선 위치에서 시작하겠습니다.

간단하게 생각하세요 - 뒤쪽 트레일러를 리드하면 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Steer the lead trailer slightly away from the parking spot, and the rear trailer will start to point towards the spot. From there, adjust the angle between the lead and rear trailer to maintain a nice, smooth arch into the parking spot.
trans-unit.target: 앞쪽 트레일러를 주차 공간에서 약간 벗어나게 하면 뒤쪽 트레일러가 주차 공간을 향해 움직이기 시작합니다. 그 상태에서 앞쪽과 뒤쪽 트레일러 사이의 각도를 조정하여 주차 공간으로 부드럽게 진입하는 곡선을 유지하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Remember, if the rear trailer is coming in too tight, then you must straighten the angle of the combination some. If it is going too wide, then get the angle sharper.
trans-unit.target: 뒤쪽 트레일러가 너무 좁게 들어오면 전체 차량의 각도를 약간 조정해야 합니다. 반대로 너무 넓게 들어오면 각도를 더 날카롭게 조정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene5 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Adjustments you make with the tractor have half as much affect on the rear trailer as they do on the lead, so don't be afraid to really work your tractor.
trans-unit.target: 트랙터로 조정한 부분이 앞쪽 트레일러에 미치는 영향은 뒤쪽 트레일러에 미치는 영향의 절반 정도에 불과하므로, 트랙터를 과감하게 사용하는 것을 두려워하지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene6 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: At this point, you must start planning ahead. You must also get the lead trailer into the spot as well, so start a plan to get it straight in front of the rear.
trans-unit.target: 이 시점에서는 미리 계획을 세워야 합니다. 또한 앞쪽 트레일러도 제자리에 주차해야 하므로, 뒤쪽 트레일러 바로 앞에 주차할 수 있도록 계획을 세우십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene7
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene7 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source:
It is very rare to get the trailers in on the first attempt. In this case, we waited too long to straighten up the lead, and now the rear is drifting off path.

No problem, pull forward and try again.
trans-unit.target:
트레일러를 한 번에 제대로 주차하는 경우는 매우 드문 일입니다. 앞쪽을 바로잡는 데 너무 오래 기다리는 바람에 뒷부분이 경로에서 벗어나고 있습니다.

괜찮습니다. 앞으로 전진해서 다시 시도해 보십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene8
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene8 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Really work that wheel, and get those trailers where you want them. You can pull forward as many times as you need to until you are satisfied.
trans-unit.target: 휠을 힘껏 돌려서 트레일러를 원하는 위치에 놓으세요. 만족할 때까지 몇 번이고 앞으로 당기시면 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene9
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene9 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: And just like that, we've successfully parked B-doubles.
trans-unit.target: 이렇게 해서 우리는 B-더블 주차에 성공했습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene10
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_cutscene10 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Drive forward to the end of the lot and turn around.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Remember to make a wide turn.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

trans-unit.source: Continue forward until you feel you have adequate room to manoeuvre, then start reversing.
trans-unit.target: 충분한 공간이 확보되었다고 느껴질 때까지 전진한 다음 후진을 시작하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check2
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check3
Id: aca_msg_book3_backing_90_tight_check3 Group: Book 3 Scenario backing_90_tight

aca_scenario_book3_correcting_90_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_correcting_90_title Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you're tasked with finishing a 90-degree backing manoeuvre that somebody else gave up on.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 다른 사람이 포기한 90도 후진 조작을 완료해야 하는 임무를 맡게 됩니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_correcting_90_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_correcting_90_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

aca_goal_book3_correcting_90_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_correcting_90_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Well, once again someone has become frustrated and left their rig in the middle of the lot.
trans-unit.target: 또 누군가가 짜증이 나서 주차장 한가운데에 차를 세워두고 갔네요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Now that you've backed up a few trailers, you should have a good idea of how to proceed from here.
trans-unit.target: 트레일러 몇 대를 후진시켜 보셨으니, 이제 앞으로 어떻게 진행해야 할지 감이 잡히실 겁니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Start by pulling forward until you have something to work with.
trans-unit.target: 먼저 작업할 수 있는 부분이 보일 때까지 앞으로 당기십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: From here, you can now steer the rear trailer into the spot using the lead. Try to keep a nice arch through the combination so that everything keeps moving.
trans-unit.target: 이제 앞쪽을 이용해 뒤쪽 트레일러를 제자리에 밀어 넣으세요. 조합이 함께 움직일 수 있도록 멋진 곡선을 유지하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Takes as much time and as many corrections as you need.
trans-unit.target: 시간이 얼마나 걸리든, 수정이 얼마나 필요하든 상관없습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene5 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Straighten everything up, stop in the designated area, and secure the vehicle.
trans-unit.target: 모든 것을 정리하고 지정된 구역에 정차한 후 차량을 고정하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_cutscene6 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

trans-unit.source: Drive forward out of this mess so that you can better work the trailers into the spot.
trans-unit.target: 이 혼잡한 곳에서 앞으로 차를 몰아 트레일러를 주차 공간에 더 잘 넣을 수 있도록 하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_correcting_90_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario correcting_90

aca_scenario_book3_parallel_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_parallel_title Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, we'll parallel park a set of B-doubles on a roadway.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 B-더블 세트를 도로에 평행 주차하는 상황을 가정해 보겠습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_parallel_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_parallel_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

aca_goal_book3_parallel_check1
Id: aca_goal_book3_parallel_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Proceed around the corner and onto the roadway. You'll find an open spot for you there.
trans-unit.target: 코너를 돌아 도로로 나가면 빈자리가 있을 겁니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Pull into the parking spot, and drive through it; this will help get your trailers closer to where you need to be.
trans-unit.target: 주차 공간에 차를 대고 안으로 들어가세요. 이렇게 하면 트레일러를 필요한 위치에 더 가까이 옮길 수 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Continue out of the parking spot, and pull forward far enough that you have room to manoeuvre.
trans-unit.target: 주차 공간에서 나와 앞으로 충분히 전진하여 차량을 조작할 공간을 확보하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene3
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene3 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Using your lead trailer to steer, push your rear trailer into the spot. You will really need to plan ahead to ensure each trailer ends up where you want it.
trans-unit.target: 앞쪽 트레일러를 조종하여 뒤쪽 트레일러를 제자리에 밀어 넣으세요. 각 트레일러가 원하는 위치에 정확히 자리 잡도록 미리 계획을 세우는 것이 중요합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene4
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene4 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: You may have to pull forwards and backwards a few times to get everything where you want it.
trans-unit.target: 원하는 위치에 모든 것을 놓으려면 앞뒤로 몇 번 당겨야 할 수도 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene5
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene5 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Once you are satisfied that you are lined up with the edge of the road, centre the combination in the parking spot, and secure the vehicle.
trans-unit.target: 차량이 도로 가장자리와 일직선으로 정렬되었는지 확인한 후, 주차 공간 중앙에 주차 스위치를 맞추고 차량을 잠그십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene6
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_cutscene6 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Drive forward, find your parking spot, and set your vehicle up to reverse in.
trans-unit.target: 차를 앞으로 움직여 주차 공간을 찾은 다음, 후진 주차를 준비하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

aca_msg_book3_parallel_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

aca_msg_book3_parallel_stop
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_stop Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

trans-unit.source: Secure the truck and shut down the engine.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_parallel_end
Id: aca_msg_book3_parallel_end Group: Book 3 Scenario parallel

aca_scenario_book3_depot_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_depot_title Group: Book 3 Scenario depot

trans-unit.source: Park in one of the three parking spots provided.
trans-unit.target: 제공된 세 곳의 주차 공간 중 한 곳에 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_depot_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_depot_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario depot

trans-unit.source: Park in any of the parking spots indicated.
trans-unit.target: 표시된 주차 공간 중 아무 곳에나 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_depot_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_depot_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario depot

trans-unit.source: Park in one of the three parking spots provided.
trans-unit.target: 제공된 세 곳의 주차 공간 중 한 곳에 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_depot_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_depot_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario depot

aca_scenario_book3_lucky_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_lucky_title Group: Book 3 Scenario lucky

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you must escape not only a busy truck stop, but also navigate the busy intersections on the road.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 혼잡한 트럭 휴게소를 탈출해야 할 뿐만 아니라 도로 위의 복잡한 교차로도 안전하게 통과해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_lucky_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_lucky_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario lucky

trans-unit.source:
Packed parking lots can be the bane of any trucker, but for those pulling B-doubles it is especially difficult to navigate them.

You'll have to get creative to get out of this one.
trans-unit.target:
꽉 찬 주차장은 모든 트럭 운전사에게 골칫거리이지만, 특히 B-더블을 운전하는 사람들에게는 더욱 어렵습니다.

이런 상황에서 벗어나려면 기발한 방법을 생각해내야 할 겁니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_lucky_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_lucky_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario lucky

trans-unit.source: Find a way out of the parking lot and out onto the road.
trans-unit.target: 주차장에서 나와 도로로 나갈 길을 찾으십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_lucky_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_lucky_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario lucky

aca_scenario_book3_night_slalom_double_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_night_slalom_double_title night_slalom_double

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you will face some irregular slaloms in total darkness.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 칠흑 같은 어둠 속에서 불규칙한 슬라롬 코스를 통과해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_night_slalom_double_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_night_slalom_double_desc

trans-unit.source: The course ahead has a couple slaloms with varying difficulty throughout them.
trans-unit.target: 앞쪽 코스에는 난이도가 다양한 슬라롬 구간이 몇 군데 있습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene01
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene01

trans-unit.source: Take your time, and remember to plan ahead as you drive through.
trans-unit.target: 서두르지 마시고, 운전하면서 미리 계획을 세우는 것을 잊지 마십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene02
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene02

trans-unit.source:
There may be spots where you have to slow to a crawl and be very precise.

Don't rush it!
trans-unit.target:
어떤 구간에서는 속도를 아주 천천히 줄이고 정확하게 운전해야 할 수도 있습니다.

서두르지 마십시오!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene03
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_cutscene03

trans-unit.source:
Proceed forward when you are ready.

Don't forget to turn on your lights!
trans-unit.target:
준비가 되시면 앞으로 나아가세요.

조명을 켜는 것을 잊지 마십시오!

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_forward

aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_check0
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_check0

aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_stop
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_stop

trans-unit.source: Secure the vehicle and shut off the engine.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_end
Id: aca_msg_book3_night_slalom_double_end

aca_scenario_book3_trckstp_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_trckstp_title Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you must navigate your way through a busy lot full of inconveniently parked trucks to park around a curve.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 불편하게 주차된 트럭들로 가득 찬 혼잡한 주차장을 헤쳐나가 커브길에 주차해야 합니다.

context-group.context:
aca_scenario_book3_trckstp_desc
Id: aca_scenario_book3_trckstp_desc Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source: It's not uncommon to arrive to a lot that is almost completely full of trucks, leaving you with very few options for parking yourself.
trans-unit.target: 주차장이 트럭으로 거의 꽉 차 있어서 직접 주차할 공간이 거의 없는 경우가 드물지 않습니다.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_trckstp_cutscene1
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_cutscene1 Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source:
In this case, there is only one place left where you can fit with your B-double combination.

Drive through the lot and park in the curve near the exit.
trans-unit.target:
이 경우, B-더블이 주차할 수 있는 자리는 단 한 곳만 남았습니다.

주차장을 통과하여 출구 근처 커브길에 주차하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_trckstp_cutscene2
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_cutscene2 Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source:
Make your way through the lot and park along the curve.

Proceed when you're ready.
trans-unit.target:
주차장을 가로질러 커브길에 주차하세요.

준비가 되면 진행하십시오.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_trckstp_forward
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_forward Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source: You won't be able to fit through the turn here, you'll have to back up and find another way through.
trans-unit.target: 여기서는 커브길을 통과할 수 없으니 후진해서 다른 길을 찾아야 할 거예요.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_trckstp_check1
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

aca_msg_book3_trckstp_check2
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

aca_msg_book3_trckstp_stop
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_stop Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

trans-unit.source: Secure the truck and shut down the engine.

context-group.context:
aca_msg_book3_trckstp_end
Id: aca_msg_book3_trckstp_end Group: Book 3 Scenario Truckstop Angle

aca_scenario_book3_finex_title
Id: aca_scenario_book3_finex_title Group: Book 3 Scenario finex

trans-unit.source: In this scenario, you'll put your new skills to the test in a course designed to test your precision and understanding of driving with B-doubles.
trans-unit.target: 이 시나리오에서는 운전의 정확성과 이해도를 B-더블로 테스트하기 위해 설계된 과정에서 새로운 기술을 테스트하게 됩니다.

Id: aca_goal_book3_finex_check1 Group: Book 3 Scenario finex

Id: aca_goal_book3_finex_check2 Group: Book 3 Scenario finex

aca_goal_book3_finex_check22

aca_goal_book3_finex_speed
Id: aca_goal_book3_finex_speed Group: Book 3 Scenario finex

aca_goal_book3_finex_check5
Id: aca_goal_book3_finex_check5 Group: Book 3 Scenario finex

trans-unit.source:
Welcome to the final exam. We've laid out some realistic situations that you could encounter out on the road to see how you are able to handle them. As always, take your time and be precise.

Good luck!
trans-unit.target:
최종 시험에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 실제 도로에서 마주칠 수 있는 몇 가지 현실적인 상황을 준비했으니, 이러한 상황에 어떻게 대처하는지 살펴보겠습니다. 언제나처럼, 시간을 충분히 갖고 정확하게 문제를 풀어주세요.

행운을 빕니다!

Id: tb_wa1 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: The Olympic Peninsula reveals a place where ocean, forest, and mountains coexist in ever-changing beauty. Mist drifts over rocky shores, while waterfalls tumble from the highlands, where hidden valleys shelter small historic towns.
trans-unit.target: The Olympic Peninsula reveals a place where ocean, forest, and mountains coexist in ever-changing beauty. Mist drifts over rocky shores, while waterfalls tumble from the highlands, where hidden valleys shelter small historic towns.

tb_wa1_desc

poi_wa1_01
Id: poi_wa1_01 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Completed in 1893 on a bluff above Port Townsend’s waterfront, the building was designed as a federal facility with a customhouse, reflecting the city’s early ambitions as an emerging hub of international trade.
trans-unit.target: Completed in 1893 on a bluff above Port Townsend’s waterfront, the building was designed as a federal facility with a customhouse, reflecting the city’s early ambitions as an emerging hub of international trade.

poi_wa1_02
Id: poi_wa1_02 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Port Angeles is a coastal city founded in the 19th century as a harbour and supply point. Today, it serves as a key gateway to Olympic National Park and a ferry port linking the United States and Canada.
trans-unit.target: Port Angeles is a coastal city founded in the 19th century as a harbour and supply point. Today, it serves as a key gateway to Olympic National Park and a ferry port linking the United States and Canada.

poi_wa1_02_desc
Id: poi_wa1_02_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa1_03
Id: poi_wa1_03 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Lake Crescent, Washington’s second-deepest lake, is known for its vivid blue, crystal-clear waters, a result of low nitrogen levels. Set within a popular recreational area, it is surrounded by trails and old-growth forest.
trans-unit.target: Lake Crescent, Washington’s second-deepest lake, is known for its vivid blue, crystal-clear waters, a result of low nitrogen levels. Set within a popular recreational area, it is surrounded by trails and old-growth forest.

Id: poi_wa1_03_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa1_04
Id: poi_wa1_04 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Kalaloch Beach is known for the “Tree of Life,” a Sitka spruce with exposed roots spanning a small creek to the shore. Unlike typical tall spruces, it is shorter, thicker, and windswept, making it a unique and popular local landmark.
trans-unit.target: Kalaloch Beach is known for the “Tree of Life,” a Sitka spruce with exposed roots spanning a small creek to the shore. Unlike typical tall spruces, it is shorter, thicker, and windswept, making it a unique and popular local landmark.

context-group.context:
poi_wa1_04_desc
Id: poi_wa1_04_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa1_05
Id: poi_wa1_05 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Olympic National Park protects diverse ecosystems, from a rugged Pacific coastline and temperate rainforests to alpine peaks. First classified as a National Monument in 1909, it was renamed a National Park by the federal government in 1938.
trans-unit.target: Olympic National Park protects diverse ecosystems, from a rugged Pacific coastline and temperate rainforests to alpine peaks. First classified as a National Monument in 1909, it was renamed a National Park by the federal government in 1938.

poi_wa1_05_desc
Id: poi_wa1_05_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa1_06
Id: poi_wa1_06 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Greenhead Slough is a small inlet and wetland channel along Highway 101 near Willapa Bay. It lies within a coastal estuary habitat that has been restored to support salmon spawning and abundant waterfowl viewing.
trans-unit.target: Greenhead Slough is a small inlet and wetland channel along Highway 101 near Willapa Bay. It lies within a coastal estuary habitat that has been restored to support salmon spawning and abundant waterfowl viewing.

poi_wa1_07
Id: poi_wa1_07 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Dabob Bay is a deep fjord that supports salmon, shellfish and wildlife. The Dabob Bay Natural Area, established in 1984, protects rare salt marsh and sand-spit plant communities within a highly functional tidal wetland system.
trans-unit.target: Dabob Bay is a deep fjord that supports salmon, shellfish and wildlife. The Dabob Bay Natural Area, established in 1984, protects rare salt marsh and sand-spit plant communities within a highly functional tidal wetland system.

poi_wa1_07_desc
Id: poi_wa1_07_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

tb_wa2
Id: tb_wa2 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Washington’s heartland invites travellers along picturesque roads through evergreen forests and calm alpine lakes. Mount Rainier dominates the horizon, offering iconic views and a peaceful journey into the natural landscapes of the Pacific Northwest.
trans-unit.target: Washington’s heartland invites travellers along picturesque roads through evergreen forests and calm alpine lakes. Mount Rainier dominates the horizon, offering iconic views and a peaceful journey into the natural landscapes of the Pacific Northwest.

context-group.context:
tb_wa2_desc
Id: tb_wa2_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_01
Id: poi_wa2_01 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Mount Rainier, Washington’s tallest peak at 14,411 feet, is an active stratovolcano. Its glaciers feed rivers, shape valleys, and sustain rich forests and wildlife, making it a vital natural landmark.
trans-unit.target: Mount Rainier, Washington’s tallest peak at 14,411 feet, is an active stratovolcano. Its glaciers feed rivers, shape valleys, and sustain rich forests and wildlife, making it a vital natural landmark.

context-group.context:
poi_wa2_01_desc
Id: poi_wa2_01_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_02
Id: poi_wa2_02 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Wenatchee National Forest spans mountains, rivers, and alpine valleys. In 1933, the Civilian Conservation Corps built trails and fire lookouts here, leaving a lasting mark on the forest’s recreational and conservation history.
trans-unit.target: Wenatchee National Forest spans mountains, rivers, and alpine valleys. In 1933, the Civilian Conservation Corps built trails and fire lookouts here, leaving a lasting mark on the forest’s recreational and conservation history.

context-group.context:
poi_wa2_02_desc
Id: poi_wa2_02_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_03
Id: poi_wa2_03 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Mount Baker–Snoqualmie National Forest hosts some of the oldest glacier-monitoring sites in America, tracking volcanic ice flows and climate changes across the Cascades since the early 1900s.
trans-unit.target: Mount Baker–Snoqualmie National Forest hosts some of the oldest glacier-monitoring sites in America, tracking volcanic ice flows and climate changes across the Cascades since the early 1900s.

context-group.context:
poi_wa2_03_desc
Id: poi_wa2_03_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_04
Id: poi_wa2_04 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Along the Wenatchee River, remnants of early 19th-century irrigation canals and mills show how settlers harnessed its waters. Native tribes also relied on its salmon-rich waters for food and trade long before European settlement.
trans-unit.target: Along the Wenatchee River, remnants of early 19th-century irrigation canals and mills show how settlers harnessed its waters. Native tribes also relied on its salmon-rich waters for food and trade long before European settlement.

poi_wa2_04_desc
Id: poi_wa2_04_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_05
Id: poi_wa2_05 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: First ascended in the mid-20th century, Klawatti Peak remains rarely climbed due to its steep, glacier-covered slopes, making it a coveted challenge for mountaineers seeking isolation in the North Cascades.
trans-unit.target: First ascended in the mid-20th century, Klawatti Peak remains rarely climbed due to its steep, glacier-covered slopes, making it a coveted challenge for mountaineers seeking isolation in the North Cascades.

poi_wa2_05_desc
Id: poi_wa2_05_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_06
Id: poi_wa2_06 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Constructed to manage local waterways, Dry Falls Dam sits atop prehistoric basalt cliffs, controlling seasonal flows while revealing terraces and plunge pools carved by Ice Age floods.
trans-unit.target: Constructed to manage local waterways, Dry Falls Dam sits atop prehistoric basalt cliffs, controlling seasonal flows while revealing terraces and plunge pools carved by Ice Age floods.

Id: poi_wa2_06_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

poi_wa2_07
Id: poi_wa2_07 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: The overlook features interpretive signs about the 1988 White Mountain Fire, one of Washington’s largest wildfires in recent history, revealing scars and regrowth patterns in the forest.
trans-unit.target: The overlook features interpretive signs about the 1988 White Mountain Fire, one of Washington’s largest wildfires in recent history, revealing scars and regrowth patterns in the forest.

context-group.context:
poi_wa2_07_desc
Id: poi_wa2_07_desc Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: Before 1980, Mount St. Helens had a conical shape and was referred to as the Mount Fuji of America. The 1980 eruption removed 1,300 ft of its summit, forming a horseshoe crater now partly filled by a lava dome and glacier.
trans-unit.target: Before 1980, Mount St. Helens had a conical shape and was referred to as the Mount Fuji of America. The 1980 eruption removed 1,300 ft of its summit, forming a horseshoe crater now partly filled by a lava dome and glacier.

trans-unit.source: East of the Cascades, Washington’s Wine Country spans the Columbia Valley AVA. The region includes Selah Creek, Lewis and Clark State Park, and lands historically inhabited by Indigenous peoples, featuring dry, sunny landscapes with rolling hills and river valleys.
trans-unit.target: East of the Cascades, Washington’s Wine Country spans the Columbia Valley AVA. The region includes Selah Creek, Lewis and Clark State Park, and lands historically inhabited by Indigenous peoples, featuring dry, sunny landscapes with rolling hills and river valleys.

trans-unit.source: Clear Creek Falls Overlook is a popular stop just east of White Pass Summit. About a mile further east, the turn-off leads to Clear Lake Recreation Area, known for fishing and excellent opportunities to observe local wildlife.
trans-unit.target: Clear Creek Falls Overlook is a popular stop just east of White Pass Summit. About a mile further east, the turn-off leads to Clear Lake Recreation Area, known for fishing and excellent opportunities to observe local wildlife.

Id: poi_wa3_02 Group: Washington TBs and POIs localization.

trans-unit.source: The Fred G. Redmon Bridge, or Selah Creek Bridge, is a twin-arch structure in Yakima County. When completed, it was the longest concrete-arch bridge in America and the highest automobile bridge in the state.
trans-unit.target: The Fred G. Redmon Bridge, or Selah Creek Bridge, is a twin-arch structure in Yakima County. When completed, it was the longest concrete-arch bridge in America and the highest automobile bridge in the state.

trans-unit.source: Washington’s valleys and fertile soil support many grapevines, including Riesling, Cabernet and Merlot. The vineyards are an important part of the state’s agriculture and local landscapes.
trans-unit.target: Washington’s valleys and fertile soil support many grapevines, including Riesling, Cabernet and Merlot. The vineyards are an important part of the state’s agriculture and local landscapes.

trans-unit.source: Built in 1978, the bridge, sometimes called the Intercity Bridge, crosses the Columbia River between Pasco and Kennewick in southeastern Washington. Since its opening, it has been regarded as a landmark and symbol of the Tri-Cities.
trans-unit.target: Built in 1978, the bridge, sometimes called the Intercity Bridge, crosses the Columbia River between Pasco and Kennewick in southeastern Washington. Since its opening, it has been regarded as a landmark and symbol of the Tri-Cities.

trans-unit.source: One of Washington’s first state parks, Lewis and Clark State Park preserves ancient forests along a historic Indigenous route. Named to honour the Corps of Discovery, the forests recall the dense woodlands Meriwether Lewis described in his journals.
trans-unit.target: One of Washington’s first state parks, Lewis and Clark State Park preserves ancient forests along a historic Indigenous route. Named to honour the Corps of Discovery, the forests recall the dense woodlands Meriwether Lewis described in his journals.

trans-unit.source: The Columbia County Courthouse reflects a time when county government was central to daily life. During a period of rapid growth and limited contact with the state capital, courthouses served as the main source of authority and addressed citizens’ immediate needs.
trans-unit.target: The Columbia County Courthouse reflects a time when county government was central to daily life. During a period of rapid growth and limited contact with the state capital, courthouses served as the main source of authority and addressed citizens’ immediate needs.

trans-unit.source: Grand Teton National Park is defined by its glacier-carved peaks rising sharply above Jackson Hole. Once called the “Pilot Knobs” by fur trappers for their visibility across the plains, the mountains remain among the most iconic landmarks of the American West.

trans-unit.source: Crowheart Butte is a prominent landmark named after an 1866 battle between the Shoshone and Crow tribes. According to tradition, Chief Washakie placed a Crow chief’s heart atop the butte after the Shoshone victory as a warning, giving the formation its enduring name.

trans-unit.source: Wyoming’s Red Desert is a vast high desert basin defined by wind-sculpted sand, sagebrush plains, and striking red rock formations. One of the largest uninhabited areas in North America, it is shaped by extreme climate, ancient lake beds, and long migration routes.

trans-unit.source: Red Canyon was carved during the uplift of the Wind River Range around 60 million years ago. Its distinctive red cliffs are formed from Chugwater rock, whose oxidized iron gives the canyon the vivid color that inspired its name.
trans-unit.target: Red Canyon was carved during the uplift of the Wind River Range around 60 million years ago. Its distinctive red cliffs are formed from Chugwater rock, whose oxidized iron gives the canyon the vivid color that inspired its name.

trans-unit.source: Boar’s Tusk, a volcanic rock formation rising over 400 feet above Wyoming’s Red Desert, is the eroded core of a volcano that formed millions of years ago. It overlooks the vast Killpecker Sand Dunes, part of North America’s largest active dune field.

trans-unit.source: Rock Springs is known as the “City of 56 Nationalities” for its diverse immigrant heritage. In the late 1800s, people from around the world arrived to work in Union Pacific coal mines. The city is also linked to the famous outlaw Butch Cassidy.

trans-unit.source: Butch Cassidy was a famous American outlaw who led the “Wild Bunch,” a gang known for train and bank robberies in the Old West. He earned the nickname “Butch” while working in a Rock Springs butcher shop. The most legendary and influential heist was the Wilcox Train Robbery in 1899.

He earned the nickname “Butch” while working in a Rock Springs butcher shop. The most legendary and influential heist was the Wilcox Train Robbery in 1899.

trans-unit.source: Founded in 1869 by the Union Pacific Railroad, Evanston was named after surveyor James A. Evans. The city grew as a railroad hub and later became a regional center for agriculture, oil, and gas.

trans-unit.source: Built after the Pacific Wagon Road Act of 1857, the Lander Cutoff was one of the first federally funded wagon roads in the American West. Named for engineer Frederick W. Lander, it provided a shorter route for emigrants traveling westward.

trans-unit.source: Western South Dakota is defined by the Black Hills and Badlands. Here, vast prairies rise into pine-covered mountains, granite spires, and roaming bison herds. Just beyond, the rugged Badlands reveal a striking landscape carved by wind and water over millions of years.

trans-unit.source: Known to the Lakota as Paha Sapa meaning “Hills That Are Black”, this pine-covered region is home to Black Elk Peak, South Dakota’s highest point at 7,244 feet. Renamed in honor of the famed Lakota healer, it is also the tallest summit east of the Rockies.

trans-unit.source: Mount Rushmore, known as America’s “Shrine of Democracy,” was carved into the Black Hills between 1927 and 1941. The monument features 60-foot sculptures of Presidents Washington, Jefferson, Roosevelt, and Lincoln, representing the country’s birth, growth, development and preservation.

trans-unit.source: Built in 1929, this 225-foot steel and concrete arch bridge spans a canyon near Wind Cave National Park. Rising 115 feet above the canyon floor, it is South Dakota’s only bridge of its kind and was designed to blend seamlessly with the surrounding rock.

trans-unit.source: Sturgis is known for hosting the world’s largest motorcycle rally. Started in 1938 by local Indian dealer Pappy Hoel, the annual 10-day event brings riders from around the globe to the Black Hills for motorcycle shows, races, music, and celebrations.

trans-unit.source: Deadwood rose during the Black Hills gold rush of 1876 and became one of the Wild West’s most notorious towns. Designated a National Historic Landmark in 1961, it is the only U.S. city with that status, preserving much of its historic downtown.

trans-unit.source: Badlands National Park spans 244,000 acres of buttes, pinnacles, and spires alongside the nation’s largest protected mixed-grass prairie. It also preserves one of the world’s richest fossil beds, revealing ancient mammals that once roamed the Great Plains.

trans-unit.source: Doane Robinson, known as the “Father of Mount Rushmore,” envisioned a grand monument in the Black Hills to attract visitors to South Dakota. Today, his legacy continues, with Mount Rushmore perfectly framed through the scenic Doane Robinson Tunnel.

trans-unit.source: Hot Springs, originally called Minnekahta by the Sioux for its “hot waters,” was settled in 1879 around mineral springs believed to have healing powers. Renamed in 1882, it became a health resort and remains known for the historic Evans Plunge.

trans-unit.source: The Mammoth Site is a world-famous Ice Age fossil dig where 61 mammoths have been uncovered. Discovered in 1974, the ancient sinkhole preserves the largest collection of Columbian mammoth remains in North America, with excavations still ongoing today.

trans-unit.source: South Dakota’s Missouri River region marks the state’s central divide, with broad plains on one side and rolling hills on the other. It was a key corridor for Native nations, fur traders, and Lewis and Clark, and later became home to major dams, frontier towns, and rich river history.

It was a key corridor for Native nations, fur traders, and Lewis and Clark, and later became home to major dams, frontier towns, and rich river history.

trans-unit.source: Created by dams on the Missouri River in the late 1940s, Lakes Oahe, Sharpe, Francis Case, and Lewis & Clark now define central South Dakota. Together, these reservoirs provide more than 440 miles of shoreline for boating, fishing, and recreation.

trans-unit.source: Bangor was once the county seat of Walworth County but became a ghost town after its buildings were moved to nearby Selby in 1899. Today, only a monument marks the site where the town once stood.

trans-unit.source: Founded in 1880, Pierre became South Dakota’s capital when the state joined the Union in 1889. Chosen for its central location and Missouri River crossing, the city was named after French-American fur trader Pierre Chouteau Jr.

trans-unit.source: The Corn Palace in Mitchell is the world’s only palace decorated entirely with corn. Each year, local artists and farmers create new murals using naturally colored corn, grains, and grasses, making it one of South Dakota’s most unique landmarks.

trans-unit.source: Huron is home to the World’s Largest Pheasant, a 40-foot-tall fiberglass and steel sculpture built in 1959. Weighing 22 tons, it celebrates the region’s long-standing reputation as one of America’s premier pheasant hunting destinations.

trans-unit.source: Dignity Of Earth & Sky is a 50-foot stainless steel sculpture overlooking the Missouri River near Chamberlain. Created by artist Dale Lamphere, it honors the heritage, resilience, and cultures of the Lakota and Dakota people.

trans-unit.source: Fort Randall Dam, completed in 1953 within the rolling plain of the Missouri Plateau, is one of six major federal dams. It generates hydropower, forms Lake Francis Case, and helps reduce downstream flooding across the Missouri and Mississippi River basins.
